name: Monarch Bay Plaza
demographics: Monarch Bay Plaza serves the affluent coastal community of Dana Point and surrounding South Orange County areas, attracting upper-middle to high-income households with median incomes exceeding $100,000. The primary visitor base consists of families aged 35-65, including both established professionals and retirees drawn to the coastal lifestyle. The trade area captures local residents seeking convenient neighborhood shopping, as well as tourists and beach-goers visiting the Dana Point coastline, creating a mix of regular customers and seasonal traffic with preferences for quality dining, specialty retail, and service-oriented businesses.
description: Monarch Bay Plaza is a neighborhood shopping center located along the scenic Pacific Coast Highway in Dana Point, California, serving the upscale coastal communities of South Orange County. Situated at 32840 California 1, this convenient plaza offers residents and visitors easy access to a curated mix of retail shops, dining establishments, and essential services. The center benefits from its prime location in the prestigious Monarch Bay area, known for its luxury homes, pristine beaches, and resort-style living. With operating hours from 7:00 AM to 10:00 PM daily, Monarch Bay Plaza caters to the needs of the local community throughout the day, whether shoppers are looking for morning coffee, lunch destinations, or evening dining options. The plaza's strong reputation is reflected in its impressive 4.5-star rating from over 730 reviews, demonstrating consistent customer satisfaction and its role as a valued neighborhood gathering place in one of Orange County's most desirable coastal communities.
summary: Monarch Bay Plaza is a well-regarded neighborhood shopping center on Pacific Coast Highway in Dana Point, serving the affluent coastal community with convenient retail, dining, and services. With a 4.5-star rating and prime location near Monarch Beach, it offers residents and visitors quality options in one of South Orange County's most prestigious areas.
